text:
maria: Quick alert after the kernel-picker v2 push p99 on host-preproc trended up ~16% for short streams (<120 tokens). Seems tied to new kernel assignment 'quant-hybrid' for short seqs. gRPC tails worse.

sam: Repro steps? any flame/prof?

maria: Repro: `wrk -t8 -c120 -d120 -s scripts/short-stream.lua`
Snapshot (perf sampling top lines):
``nframe_parse_proto 31%
writev_fragments 25%
kv_bucket_spread 11%
batcher_emit 6%
alloc_frame_objs 9%
other 18%
```

raj: Observed avg_batch_size 4.8 -> 2.1 on impacted hosts. KV hit-rate for identical payloads split across kernel-tagged prefixes: 96% -> 83%. Key example: `k:v:model:hash=0x9f2:kernel=quant-hybrid` vs `...=fastpath-v3`.

luis: Two effects: 1) picker influences batching hints so windows close earlier (smaller batches), 2) kernel-specific key suffixes fragment kvcache. Smaller batches multiply syscalls and increase writev fragmentation which amplifies frame_parse work.

ton y: Noticed increased small-object alloc churn in preproc (frame objects) matching the timeline. GC spikes ~0.5-1.1ms occasionally.

sam: Short-term: 1) revert seq<128->quant-hybrid mapping, 2) introduce kernel-agnostic stable-prefix for short flows, 3) nudge gRPC coalesce window (2ms->5ms) to let batching recompose, 4) add tiny-frame fastpath in proto parser.

raj: Did a quick revert on 2 canaries: avg_batch_size recovered to ~4.7 and p99 dropped near baseline. Revert seems to buy time.

luis: I'll prototype a non-allocing fastpath for frames <=192B (checksum cheap-scan + inline parse). Local microbench shows ~22% fewer cycles for tiny frames. Also drafting stable-prefix patch that strips kernel suffix for short keys.

maria: Good. Please add metrics: `batch_size_by_kernel`, `kv_bucket_spread`, `frame_parse_allocs`, `writev_fragment_ratio`. These will let us guard future picker changes.

sam: I'll open rollback PR and a low-risk coalesce bump for host-preproc. If rollback holds we'll stage luis's fastpath + stable-prefix behind a feature flag and re-roll the picker with canary metrics.

deploy-bot: kernel-picker v2 rolled at 6309999000 by infra-release. Rollback patch available.

maria: Action items: sam - rollback PR + coalesce bump; luis - fastpath + stable-prefix canary; raj - kv key heatmap + canary traces; tony - GC/alloc deeper profile. After each change run 1h wrk + pprof and paste links. Tagging SRE. :thumbsup:
